title: Small steps: The boundary survives an apology
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Own impact, keep reasonable limits and create a concrete path back into relationship and learning.
pressureLine: I'm sorry, but you made me shout.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
practice: own the delivery and restate the limit calmly
principle: Model an apology that owns adult behaviour without shifting blame.
nextSentence: The reasonable boundary remains. First, own the delivery and restate the limit calmly.
keyLearning: Model an apology that owns adult behaviour without shifting blame.
